recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: midsummer fog rolling through san francisco before noon
browser betas stacking quietly in the summer heat
hardware video pipelines waking from a long sleep
craft argued against excess on the front page
long july evenings stretching past eight

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Drift a lone sailboat through rolling fog banks at dawn, snatching golden sunrise tokens before the grey swallows the bay.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each token bleeds warm color back into a washed-out grey world
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, lanes narrow, wind pushes you off-center
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor grey lifting into amber gold

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap in rhythm as browser patch-note tiles cascade down — merge decode blocks before the beta timer expires.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap on beat to snap tiles together
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: completing a patch chain triggers a satisfying ship-it flash
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: cascade speed doubles, off-beat tiles stack and clog the pipeline
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: retro terminal green on charcoal with pixel fox accents

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw routing paths for parallel agents navigating a one-screen codebase maze — keep them from colliding while they race to ship.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to sketch agent routes, release to launch
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: all agents reaching the deploy node in sync triggers a flow-state pulse
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more agents spawn mid-round, maze walls shift, routes cross
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe on a dark IDE grid

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick surgical darts at bloated UI layers — trim the excess to reveal the clean design underneath without hitting essential elements.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick to throw precision trim darts
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each clean peel exposes a sharper interface layer with a crisp snap
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: bloat regenerates faster, essential elements shrink into harder targets
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout layers peeling away to reveal minimal white space
